description: Defines a type-safe variant (union) class template for storing one of multiple types, along with associated utility functions, type traits, and specializations for external use.

classes.name: android::pdx::rpc::Variant
classes.description: A type-safe union class template that can hold one of multiple specified types, with methods for construction, assignment, visitation, and type queries.

methods.name: Visit
methods.description: Invokes a provided callable on the active element of the variant.

methods.name: Destruct
methods.description: Destroys the active element of the variant.

methods.name: Become
methods.description: Replaces the current active element with a new one constructed from provided arguments.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Returns the index of the active element or -1 if empty.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Checks if a specific type is currently active.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Accesses the active element as a specific type or by index.
